A comfortable, reusable face mask for everyday wear
Our Funkins Reusable Cloth Face Mask is a smart, eco-friendly solution to keep your face, mouth,and nose covered from unwanted elements that linger in the air. Made from super soft cotton fabric that is comfortable and breathable, each fitted mask is designed to hug your face gently while providing necessary coverage, and features adjustable soft elastic ear loops to make sure your mask stays securely in place all day long.

Getting your child to wear a mask can be a challenge, and seeing adults in dark colored face coverings can be intimidating for little ones. Funkins fitted face masks are:
- Available in two sizes: The kids size is made for children ages 3 to 9. The adult size is suitable for bigger kids and adults.
- Machine washable, reusable
- Made of breathable, cotton fabric
- Decorated with fun, whimsical patterns
- Not suitable for children 2 and under
- For consumer use only. Not for professional use

Face the day, the Funkins way!
In March 2020, as a result of the current global situation, our company repurposed fabrics from our napkin lines in order to make washable and reusable fabric face masks for adults and children ages 4 and up. description: We originally designed the NXTGEN EasyFlow Mask in March 2020 for use by frontline healthcare workers during extreme PPE shortages. Model F0230 is a compact and shallow design so that downward visibility during procedures is preserved and it can be worn with other PPE, loops and lights under a shield. While most respirators are rather deep, our unique design has a similar low profile fit to a surgical mask, with the robust filtering ability of a respirator. The unique silicone gasket design allows flexible placement on the face. Those with small faces can tuck the chin inside the mask, medium size faces can wear the mask on the chin and those with larger faces can wear above the chin but below the mouth, allowing one size to fit most. The NXTGEN EasyFlow Mask Model F0230 is available to both clinicians and the general public. Please consider the shallow design of this mask, as it is designed for a low profile fit. This may cause discomfort for some, especially those with larger noses. To date, we have tens of thousands of masks in use, the majority of which are worn by frontline healthcare workers worldwide. In the clinical setting, we have a 90% positive fitment rate with one size.  Every mask set includes (5) genuine Hollingsworth & Vose Technostat filters.  Technostat meets HEPA standards and is extremely efficient at filtering sub-micron particles. It is a needle punch nonwoven textile that is electrostatically charged. These HV filters are among the finest available and the heart of our mask. While melt-blown filter media mostly mechanically filters like a strainer, our Technostat filters are triboelectric charged. This electrostatic charging causes fine particles to cling to the tiny fibers it is constructed of. This allows the filter media to be much more airy and breathable, while still providing robust HEPA level filtration. Our unique design also features a moisture outlet that can be fully filtered if desired.

FAQ:

Q: What type of material is polyurethane?
A: It is a soft elastic material widely used for things like cosmetics powder puffs.

Q: How effective is it at keeping out dust?
A: It is capable of filtering out 99% of dust. However, no matter how high the degree of filter a product offers, if it doesn't fit you face dust will get in through gaps between the mask and your face.

Q: Doesn't such a tight seal make it hard to breathe?
A: The material has excellent air permeability, so doesn't interfere with breathing.
* The porous filter technology employed by IFFEI MASK delivers overwhelming air permeability unmatched by other polyurethane materials.
* Feel may vary for individual users.

Q: Doesn't it make your ears hurt?
A: Because it's made completely of polyurethane, the entire mask expands evenly so that your ears don't hurt.
* Plus, the part that hooks over your ears has been made wider to keep ears from hurting.

Q: Which way is up?
A: The pointed part shown in the illustration should be on top. See the back of the package for details. Please note that there may be a gap around the bridge of your nose if you wear the mask upside down. Any gaps around the face will allow dust to get in. So please be careful to wear correctly.

Q: How do you wash it? Won't it get stretched out?
A: Wash by hand, then dry away from direct sunlight. Can be washed and reused repeatedly, with filter performance unaffected, even after 3 washes (blocks 99%* of dust). Also, it will not get stretched out even when washed. Please wash daily after use.

Q: Can I use detergent?
A: It's okay if you use a neutral detergent that is neither acidic nor alkaline. After washing, be sure to rinse thoroughly before you use it again. Thank you.

A COMFORTABLE REUSABLE FACE MASK RESPIRATOR THAT REDUCES WASTE

Gill Mask is a lightweight / small respirator mask that’s appropriate for clinical, office or everyday use. Wear Gill Mask where an airtight seal is needed for protection but an industrial respirator would be too heavy or bulky.

 

FEATURES

  • Extend disposable face mask supplies by up to 600%. Most respirators are either disposable or require expensive, difficult to find filters. Gill Mask allows you to take a small portion of a suitable filter media and place it into our unique filter adapter. This saves you cost and reduces waste.

  • Sterilize and Re-Use the Mask up to 2 years.

 

TIPS

  • Select the right filter to balance protection and breathability. Gill Mask does not ship with a filter — it does allow you to use any disposable face mask as a filter.  Thicker does not mean more protection — there can be a big difference in thickness between 3-ply disposable masks.
  • Use the included cartridge to help you cut the perfect size filter. Just clamp the cartridge over a face mask and cut.  Easy! The trend is most face masks have a side that faces out and one that faces in.
  • To obtain a good fit tighten the strap and then press the mask to your face with your hand and breathing in to form a seal.
  • Professional users should be fit tested by a certified tester.

 

Please note that we DO NOT ship surgical masks or other filter materials along with the Gill respirator.

description:
FAQ:

Q: What type of material is polyurethane?
A: It is a soft elastic material widely used for things like cosmetics powder puffs.

Q: How effective is it at keeping out dust?
A: It is capable of filtering out 99% of dust. However, no matter how high the degree of filter a product offers, if it doesn't fit you face dust will get in through gaps between the mask and your face.

Q: Doesn't such a tight seal make it hard to breathe?
A: The material has excellent air permeability, so doesn't interfere with breathing.
* The porous filter technology employed by IFFEI MASK delivers overwhelming air permeability unmatched by other polyurethane materials.
* Feel may vary for individual users.

Q: Doesn't it make your ears hurt?
A: Because it's made completely of polyurethane, the entire mask expands evenly so that your ears don't hurt.
* Plus, the part that hooks over your ears has been made wider to keep ears from hurting.

Q: Which way is up?
A: The pointed part shown in the illustration should be on top. See the back of the package for details. Please note that there may be a gap around the bridge of your nose if you wear the mask upside down. Any gaps around the face will allow dust to get in. So please be careful to wear correctly.

Q: How do you wash it? Won't it get stretched out?
A: Wash by hand, then dry away from direct sunlight. Can be washed and reused repeatedly, with filter performance unaffected, even after 3 washes (blocks 99%* of dust). Also, it will not get stretched out even when washed. Please wash daily after use.

Q: Can I use detergent?
A: It's okay if you use a neutral detergent that is neither acidic nor alkaline. After washing, be sure to rinse thoroughly before you use it again. Thank you.

What is a DISPOSABLE FACE MASK?:

Face masks help  When someone talks, coughs, or sneezes they may release tiny drops into the air that can infect others. If someone is ill a 3 PLY face masks can protect other people from becoming sick. Mask also protects the wearer’s nose and mouth from splashes or sprays of body fluids.
 

How to put on a face mask:

  • Clean your hands with soap and water or hand sanitizer before
  • Remove a disposable mask from the box, make sure there are no obvious tears or holes in either side. Handle masks from the ear-loops only
  • Side of the mask that has a stiff bendable edge is the top and is meant to be on the nose
  • Colored side of the mask is usually the front and should face away from you, while the black side touches your face
  • Hold the mask by the ear loops. Place a loop around each ear
  • Press the nose wire to mould in the shape of your nose and the make sure the other side comes under your chin
     

How to remove a face mask

  • Avoid touching the front of the mask. The front of the mask is contaminated. Only touch the ear loops/ties/band
  • Hold both of the ear loops and gently lift and remove the mask
  • Clean your hands with soap+water or hand sanitizer before and after handling

Disposable face mask instructions:

The disposable face mask should only be used once and then thrown into the trash. You should also remove and replace the mask when it becomes wet.

How to wear the disposable face masks:

1.   Clean your hands with water and soap or hand sanitizer before touching the disposable face mask.

2.  The side with the hard bendable edge is the top, which is used to fit the shape of the nose.

3.   Hold the mask by the ear loops. Place a loop on each ear.

4.   Mold or pinch the hard bendable edge to the shape of your nose.

5.   Pull the bottom of the mask over your mouth and chin.

How to remove the face masks:

Clean your hands with water and soap or hand sanitizer before touching the face mask. Only touch the earloops/ties/bands but not the front of the face mask as it may have been contaminated. Only touch the ear loops/ties/band.

description: We originally designed the NXTGEN EasyFlow Mask in March 2020 for use by frontline healthcare workers during extreme PPE shortages. Model F0230 is a compact and shallow design so that downward visibility during procedures is preserved and it can be worn with other PPE, loops and lights under a shield. While most respirators are rather deep, our unique design has a similar low profile fit to a surgical mask, with the robust filtering ability of a respirator. The unique silicone gasket design allows flexible placement on the face. Those with small faces can tuck the chin inside the mask, medium size faces can wear the mask on the chin and those with larger faces can wear above the chin but below the mouth, allowing one size to fit most. The NXTGEN EasyFlow Mask Model F0230 is available to both clinicians and the general public. Please consider the shallow design of this mask, as it is designed for a low profile fit. This may cause discomfort for some, especially those with larger noses. To date, we have tens of thousands of masks in use, the majority of which are worn by frontline healthcare workers worldwide. In the clinical setting, we have a 90% positive fitment rate with one size.  Every mask set includes (5) genuine Hollingsworth & Vose Technostat filters.  Technostat meets HEPA standards and is extremely efficient at filtering sub-micron particles. It is a needle punch nonwoven textile that is electrostatically charged. These HV filters are among the finest available and the heart of our mask. While melt-blown filter media mostly mechanically filters like a strainer, our Technostat filters are triboelectric charged. This electrostatic charging causes fine particles to cling to the tiny fibers it is constructed of. This allows the filter media to be much more airy and breathable, while still providing robust HEPA level filtration. Our unique design also features a moisture outlet that can be fully filtered if desired.
